meta.title: Automatic assignment also uses the new text
gaps: Signing in as the automatically assigned user and opening their notification bell requires another user session.
The catalog has no assertion for the exact new notification wording or a dynamically captured PR number in the single/plus-more format.

steps.note: Enable the company configuration required for automatic assignment.

args.goal: create or upload a new purchase requisition that is automatically assigned; stop after the screen proves the PR was created and record its PR number

steps.note: No catalog step creates or uploads a PR, so use the buyer session to perform this setup.

args.need: sign in as the user assigned to the new PR, click the top-right bell, and verify that the notification uses the new text and includes the PR number in the single or plus-more format

steps.note: The assigned user's separate login and notification view are not available to catalog steps.
Assert that the resulting notification screen is ready and has no crash or server error.
